<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market momentum:</strong> Sensex and Nifty opened higher, marking a fifth consecutive session of gains driven by strength in IT shares and a return of FII interest.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Institutional flows:</strong> While FIIs offloaded $3 billion in June, domestic institutional investors (DIIs) provided a significant cushion by purchasing $9 billion in Indian equities during the same period.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Sentiment and commodities:</strong> Indian markets are tracking a positive start supported by Wall Street&#x27;s AI-driven earnings optimism and a cooling in crude oil prices to $72 per barrel.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency movement:</strong> The Indian Rupee strengthened in early trade, rising against the US dollar as markets digest global economic cues.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
</ul>
